key_insight: High-dimensional GAN training can be reduced to deterministic ODEs driven by a probability-weighted effective covariance, making correlated latent structure analytically tractable.
engineering_relevance: The result suggests that designing generator-side covariance or preconditioning can improve subspace learning, but only within a stability window set by learning rates and noise.
method: Solve a linear-generator, quadratic-discriminator GAN in the high-dimensional limit
Extend multi-feature discriminator analysis to class-dependent, correlated, non-zero-mean latent structure
Derive mode-wise stability thresholds from the effective second moment/covariance
evidence_signal: The paper validates the ODE prediction, phase boundary, and boosting effect with numerical simulations and reports improved subspace alignment on MNIST, FashionMNIST, and CIFAR-10.
watch_item: The covariance-boosting benefit is limited by a stability interval; overly strong correlations can destabilize recovery and hurt learning.
paper_title: Effective Covariance Dynamics in Solvable High-Dimensional GANs
